INVESTING IN PEOPLE & PROGRAMS
Public education is people-intensive: 85.9% of the School Fund ($264.6M) pays for salaries, wages, and benefits.
The FY 26/27 budget fully funds the salary scales and working conditions in the division's first Collective Bargaining
Agreement, for a net workforce cost increase of $10.5 million.

FY 26/27 BUDGET IN BRIEF

5-YEAR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP)
The ACPS CIP budget is part of the Albemarle County Government adopted budget. It funds new schools, major
renovations, and the maintenance and replacement of existing facilities, buses, and technology infrastructure. The
Long Range Planning Advisory Committee and School Board develop recommendations, and funding decisions are
made by the Albemarle County Board of Supervisors. The FY 26/27 capital budget is the first year of the 5-year CIP.
